title: <anchor-dir>/chain-head.json and effects-chain-head.json
description: Restates v0.2 chain-head with typed nullable fields. CLI-computed by computeChainHead (events.js); never caller-supplied.

run_id.description: the SOURCE run dir's basename, not the anchor dir's

head_seq.description: last parseable record's seq; null if none

head_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the head physical line; null if the source was empty

line_count.description: physical lines; a torn tail counts

schema_floor.description: min schema across parseable records; null if none carry one
